answer: An agent market allocates job-bidding capacity in proportion to tokens locked for 30 days, not account count. Whether agents sell a fable, inspect a jetty, or map tundra, splitting 100 locked tokens across a thousand identities buys no more capacity than one identity. To gain more capacity, a sybil operator must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying financing costs and losing their use elsewhere for the full lock period.
